input.quote: This Agreement and the performance of transactions under this Agreement shall be governed by the substantive laws of the state of New York.
input.rationale: Section 16.9 selects New York substantive law and requires any action to be brought in a court sited within the State of New York; the Confidential Information provisions (p1499) likewise apply New York law. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned no results), so no foreign-seated arbitration risk. This meets the preferred position (New York law and New York courts). Two sub-elements fall short of the ideal wording but are not material deviations: the venue is not expressly stated to be the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, and the clause adds a mutual jury-trial waiver plus a contractual limitations period of [*] years from the date of breach — both mutual and noted for information only.
